source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
[Create a spreadsheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets)
   >   _If this is the first time, navigate to the "Accessibility Checks"
   >   sheet and copy to get started._
3. Fill out fields that are indicated as required (with \*)
4. Fill out as many optional fields as possible.
5. Take photos and upload to inspection
6. Upload photos for items with no photo
7. Note that Accessibility Check Record Name, Date, Location and inspected
   by/company fields are pre-filled.
8. Click on add inspection record to upload a new record.
9. Check "Complete" box when you're done, click on submit and Export CSV to
   get started.
10. Submit the inspection to HAP
11. _For additional information & support:_
    1. Watch the [documentation tutorial video](https://
